column2: but by code that is not

This patch adds a bitmask to the task structure that keeps track
of the trace recursion. To find the interrupt depth
algorithm is used:
level = hardirq_count() + softirq_count() + in_nmi;

column2: level will be the depth of interrutps and softirqs

column1: the nmi. Then the corresponding bit is set in the recursion bitmask.
